pages.text: Magic stats enhance your arcane abilities. There are 8 magic stats:$(li)Arcane Power - Spell damage$(li)Water Affinity - Water-based effects$(li)Earth Affinity - Earth-based effects$(li)Fire Affinity - Fire-based effects$(li)Air Affinity - Air-based effects$(li)Magic Resistance - Magic defense$(li)Casting Speed - Spell cast speed$(li)Mana Pool - Maximum mana

Magic skills are unlocked at levels 20, 50, 80 (passive) and 100 (active). At level 100:$(li)Arcane Bolt (Arcane Power)$(li)Water Heal (Water Affinity)$(li)Earth Shield (Earth Affinity)$(li)Fireball (Fire Affinity)$(li)Air Dash (Air Affinity)$(li)Magic Resist (Magic Resistance)$(li)Fast Cast (Casting Speed)$(li)Mana Regen (Mana Pool)
